# git: alias: add simulate command

Add `git simulate <command>` that shows what a git operation would do before doing it, in the spirit of [git-sim](https://initialcommit.com/blog/git-sim) — a tool that renders an animated diagram of the effect of `merge`, `rebase`, `reset`, `cherry-pick`, … on the commit graph. **Motivation:** "a better understanding of the consequences of applying some commands", especially for the author's history-rewriting aliases (`please`, `nah`, `undo`, `shake`).
